name: Galle

queries.query: Sri Lanka official cadastral parcel map Galle land registry Survey Department GIS
queries.result: Found the first-party Survey Department Land Information System description, Galle KML download index, and Sri Lanka NSDI Planning Cadastre ArcGIS service.

queries.query: ගාල්ල ඉඩම් කඩඉම් සිතියම නිල වෙබ් අඩවිය
queries.result: Search results led to the official Survey Department land-information pages; no separate Galle-local Sinhala parcel API was identified.

registryBasis: Sri Lanka Survey Department is the national surveying/mapping and cadastral authority; its public LIS page describes parcel-based land information and its public KML index lists Galle cadastral, fabric and sporadic downloads. This establishes an official source and public service, not a local municipal registry custodian.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: National LIS; searching is described by plan, location, district, DS and GN levels.
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: First-party page says LIS contains spatial and non-spatial parcel information and can expose parcel number, extent, land use and related map information, while private ownership data is censored.
Index lists Cadastre(Galle).kmz, Frabricwgs_LayerToKML(Galle).kmz and Sporadic(Galle).kmz. Anonymous downloads of Galle_Cad.kmz and Galle_Fabric.kmz succeeded.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: National planning-cadastre map service with Parcel Fabrics, Road Right of ways, SLTDA Parcels and Landuse layers.
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public ArcGIS REST service advertises JSON/GeoJSON query support and WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official LIS description loaded; no credentials or unsafe fields requested.
Galle cadastral/fabric/sporadic download links were enumerated.
Downloaded 568 KiB KMZ to ignored scratch. It contains 199 KML placemarks with cadastral-sheet style metadata such as CM No, Block_No and Sheet No; no stable parcel identity was established.

Downloaded 201 KiB KMZ to ignored scratch. It contains 121 fabric polygons with fields including objectid, district_c, plan_no and FID; these are fabric/plan coverage records, not independently verified parcel identities at the WUP point.
Inspected service configuration: layer 2 is Parcel Fabrics, polygon geometry, EPSG:4326, maxRecordCount 1000.
Inspected schema: objectid and parcel_id are present, plus plan/fabric fields; published layer extent is 79.869526706,6.716161691 to 81.324957813,8.107223758, north of the exact Galle WUP point.

Bounded WGS84 envelope 80.202,6.051 to 80.222,6.071 with where=1=1 and geometry return produced an empty GeoJSON FeatureCollection because the published layer extent does not cover Galle. No absence inference was made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Survey Department national LIS and public Galle KML exports; NSDI Planning Cadastre service is national in presentation.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Galle-specific downloadable cadastral/fabric coverage is evidenced, but parcel-level stable identity and exact citywide parcel coverage were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Galle downloads may be useful cadastral or parcel-fabric coverage, but their public KML descriptions expose sheet/fabric metadata rather than a confirmed parcel-level native identity at the exact WUP point. The NSDI parcel-fabric REST layer excludes the point by its published extent. No claim is made about parcel absence, title, ownership, registry completeness or citywide coverage.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently inspect the Galle KML layer semantics and, if parcel-level identity can be confirmed, qualify a bounded adapter using only safe IDs and geometry.
